<routing>Designated agent: `tsh-devops-engineer`; private workflow skill: `tsh-implement-pipeline`.</routing>

Implement CI/CD pipelines following platform conventions, secure OIDC and environment secrets, caching, parallelization, and appropriate rolling, blue-green, or canary deployment strategies. Escalate complex GitOps or promotion architecture to `tsh-architect`.

<required-skills>`tsh-implementing-ci-cd`, `tsh-managing-secrets`, `tsh-technical-context-discovering`</required-skills>
<workflow>Discover existing pipelines and branching/deployment targets; implement stages and protections; validate secure authentication and caching; report current state, proposed pipeline, required setup, tests, and files.</workflow>
